_설명: 설계서 11장의 회귀 사례 5종. 고정 입력(docs, ledger)과 모델 응답(llm)만으로 판정·편성·대장 결과가 정해진다. 결과는 expected.json과 비교한다.

1_late_evidence.설명: 후반 문단에만 운영 실적이 있는 사례: 1단계는 U, 본문 재분류에서 직접 해당으로 올라온다

docs.title: Fab operator shares AI update
paras: The company shared an update about its artificial intelligence program for the coming year in a short note.
It described general plans for expanding data platforms across several internal groups over time.
In the production fab, the yield analysis model has run on every lot of the memory line since September.

2_design_manufacturing_mixed.설명: 설계와 제조가 섞인 사례: 재분류 후에도 어느 분야도 직접 해당이 아니고 제외 사유도 불명확 → 판단 보류

docs.title: Design flow update touches fab data
paras: The vendor released a design flow update that also reads measurement data exported from a manufacturing line.
The release notes say the layout checker can import wafer map files, without naming any customer or site.
A roadmap slide lists a pilot with an unnamed partner but gives no scope or schedule for the work.

3_operating_and_future.설명: 운영 중인 제품과 향후 시험할 제품이 한 발표에 있는 사례: 대표 주장은 운영 중인 것 하나, 계획은 계획 유형으로 따로 기록

docs.title: Equipment maker reports monitoring results
paras: The equipment maker said its monitoring software now runs on deployed etch tools at customer sites in production.
Operators use the alerts to schedule maintenance before drift grows beyond the limits set for each recipe.
The company also plans to test a second product next year, and no results from that test exist yet.

4_rerun_no_change.설명: 전주 발표의 단순 재전재(SAME_NO_CHANGE): 게재하지 않고 근거 doc_id만 대장에 추가

docs.title: Wire repeats equipment maker announcement
paras: The equipment maker announced that its monitoring software runs on deployed etch tools at customer sites.
The announcement repeats the figures already shared the week before without any new scope or numbers.
A translated version of the same notice was posted on the regional site of the company this week.

5_stage_change.설명: 같은 사건의 단계 변경(SAME_WITH_CHANGE): 후속 기사로 채점하고 대장의 stage·claim·issues를 갱신

docs.title: Operator moves patrol robot to routine operation
paras: The operator said its sub-fab patrol robot has moved from a pilot on one line to routine operation on all lines.
Maintenance staff now receive inspection requests from the robot every shift without a manual hand-off.
The company will publish the alert conversion rate next quarter, and it has not shared that figure yet.
